designs_pixels_positive.name: designs_pixels_positive
designs_pixels_positive.value: ("designs"."width_px" IS NULL OR "designs"."width_px" > 0) AND ("designs"."height_px" IS NULL OR "designs"."height_px" > 0)

payments_succeeded_needs_event.name: payments_succeeded_needs_event
payments_succeeded_needs_event.value: "payments"."status" NOT IN ('succeeded', 'refunded') OR "payments"."confirmed_by_event_id" IS NOT NULL

quotes_delivery_window_ordered.name: quotes_delivery_window_ordered
quotes_delivery_window_ordered.value: "quotes"."delivery_min_date" IS NULL OR "quotes"."delivery_max_date" IS NULL OR "quotes"."delivery_min_date" <= "quotes"."delivery_max_date"

shipments_delivery_window_ordered.name: shipments_delivery_window_ordered
shipments_delivery_window_ordered.value: "shipments"."delivery_min_date" IS NULL OR "shipments"."delivery_max_date" IS NULL OR "shipments"."delivery_min_date" <= "shipments"."delivery_max_date"
